snippet.title: Game boy Advance Longplay [167] Super Mario Advance 3: Yoshis Island
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Amy Rose

A longplay of Super Mario Advance 3: Yoshi's Island is the GBA remake of Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island for the Game Boy Advance as part of the Super Mario Advance series. Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3 was released in 2002 and has a number of differences from the original surrounding gameplay, content and graphics, as listed below. Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3 was re-released on the 3DS's Virtual Console exclusively to 3DS Ambassadors in Australia on December 15, 2011, and in Japan, North America, and Europe on December 16, 2011. Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3 was re-released again on the Wii U's Virtual Console in North America and Europe on April 24, 2014, Europe on April 25, 2014, and in Japan on October 15, 2014. -
